beats.cap: Tactile Reflex System.
beats.speech: Tactile Reflex System.

beats.cap: A deterministic, FPGA-based safety reflex for robotic gripping.
beats.speech: A deterministic, F P G A based safety reflex for robotic gripping.

beats.cap: When a gripper squeezes too hard, the decision to stop must not wait for software.
beats.speech: When a gripper squeezes too hard, the decision to stop must not wait for software.

beats.cap: Everything in this video is simulation. No physical hardware was tested.
beats.speech: Everything in this video is simulation. No physical hardware was tested.

beats.cap: A gripper has two jobs: understand what it is touching, and react at once when the force is too high.
beats.speech: A gripper has two jobs: understand what it is touching, and react at once when the force is too high.

beats.cap: Software control loops add latency that varies: scheduling, communication, and inference time.
beats.speech: Software control loops add latency that varies: scheduling, communication, and inference time.

beats.cap: Here, the decision tree runs on a laptop. On the development host its walk averages 11.6 microseconds and peaked at 96.5, before any serial link delay.
beats.speech: Here, the decision tree runs on a laptop. On the development host its walk averages eleven point six microseconds, and peaked at ninety six point five, before any serial link delay.

beats.cap: So the work is split. The AI advises. Fixed hardware logic protects.
beats.speech: So the work is split. The A I advises. Fixed hardware logic protects.

beats.cap: The AI can only lower the command, never raise it, and the hard limits ignore it completely.
beats.speech: The A I can only lower the command, never raise it, and the hard limits ignore it completely.

beats.cap: A force sensor feeds a 12-bit AD7476A converter over SPI.
beats.speech: A force sensor feeds a twelve bit A D 7 4 7 6 A converter over S P I.

beats.cap: The ADC interface reads one 16-bit frame: four leading zeros, then twelve data bits.
beats.speech: The A D C interface reads one sixteen bit frame: four leading zeros, then twelve data bits.

beats.cap: Input conditioning registers the sample and flags invalid readings.
beats.speech: Input conditioning registers the sample and flags invalid readings.

beats.cap: A fixed 256-entry lookup table turns force into a PWM duty command.
beats.speech: A fixed two hundred fifty six entry lookup table turns force into a P W M duty command.

beats.cap: The safety governor enforces the limits and can force a safe state.
beats.speech: The safety governor enforces the limits and can force a safe state.

beats.cap: The PWM generator drives the DRV8871 motor driver.
beats.speech: The P W M generator drives the D R V 8 8 7 1 motor driver.

beats.cap: A fault handler and the emergency stop feed the governor directly.
beats.speech: A fault handler and the emergency stop feed the governor directly.

beats.cap: The advisory AI path arrives over UART, is integrity checked, and can only lower the command.
beats.speech: The advisory A I path arrives over you art, is integrity checked, and can only lower the command.

beats.cap: The target is a Terasic DE2-115 board at 50 megahertz. This is the prototype design; no physical validation is part of this work.
beats.speech: The target is a Terasic D E 2 115 board at 50 megahertz. This is the prototype design; no physical validation is part of this work.

beats.cap: In the ADC interface, a counter makes the SPI clock, samples on the falling edge, and shifts in sixteen bits. One frame takes 104 clock cycles: 2.08 microseconds.
beats.speech: In the A D C interface, a counter makes the S P I clock, samples on the falling edge, and shifts in sixteen bits. One frame takes 104 clock cycles: 2.08 microseconds.

beats.cap: A reading with a frame error, or at or above hex F F 0, is flagged invalid.
beats.speech: A reading with a frame error, or at or above hex F F zero, is flagged invalid.

beats.cap: The lookup table indexes on the top eight bits of the force code. No contact commands 180. The command ramps down to a hold level of 60, then to zero at the force limit.
beats.speech: The lookup table indexes on the top eight bits of the force code. No contact commands 180. The command ramps down to a hold level of 60, then to zero at the force limit.

beats.cap: The governor ORs every trip cause: force over limit, sensor fault, emergency stop, invalid reading, not yet armed, and predicted over-force. Any one forces the command to zero.
beats.speech: The governor ors every trip cause: force over limit, sensor fault, emergency stop, invalid reading, not yet armed, and predicted over-force. Any one forces the command to zero.

beats.cap: The PWM generator is a 12-bit counter: 12.2 kilohertz at 50 megahertz. The kill input forces the output low on the next clock.
beats.speech: The P W M generator is a twelve bit counter: 12.2 kilohertz at 50 megahertz. The kill input forces the output low on the next clock.

beats.cap: First, the force limit. The AI claims a normal grip, but force jumps above the limit of 2560 counts. The governor enters the safe state, PWM goes low, and the AI is overridden.
beats.speech: First, the force limit. The A I claims a normal grip, but force jumps above the limit of 2560 counts. The governor enters the safe state, P W M goes low, and the A I is overridden.

beats.cap: Second, predictive trip. On a fast ramp the governor watches the rise per three millisecond window. In the RTL replay it tripped at a force code of 2015, twelve steps before the limit was crossed at 2569.
beats.speech: Second, predictive trip. On a fast ramp the governor watches the rise per three millisecond window. In the R T L replay it tripped at a force code of 2015, twelve steps before the limit was crossed at 2569.

beats.cap: The price is occasional early trips: on the simulated test episodes, 6.5 percent of episodes that never reached the limit still tripped early.
beats.speech: The price is occasional early trips: on the simulated test episodes, 6.5 percent of episodes that never reached the limit still tripped early.

beats.cap: Third, hysteresis. After a trip the output stays inhibited until force falls below 2304. A force of 2304 still holds. 2303 releases.
beats.speech: Third, hysteresis. After a trip the output stays inhibited until force falls below 2304. A force of 2304 still holds. 2303 releases.

beats.cap: Fourth, the emergency stop. Safe state rises in four clock cycles and PWM is low in five: 100 nanoseconds. It stays latched until an operator clears it.
beats.speech: Fourth, the emergency stop. Safe state rises in four clock cycles and P W M is low in five: 100 nanoseconds. It stays latched until an operator clears it.

beats.cap: Fifth, invalid sensor input. One corrupted ADC frame inhibits the drive for exactly one frame and latches nothing. Four consecutive bad frames latch a sensor fault until an operator clears it.
beats.speech: Fifth, invalid sensor input. One corrupted A D C frame inhibits the drive for exactly one frame and latches nothing. Four consecutive bad frames latch a sensor fault until an operator clears it.

beats.cap: If samples stop arriving, a watchdog raises the fault at 2000 clock cycles, which is 40 microseconds.
beats.speech: If samples stop arriving, a watchdog raises the fault at 2000 clock cycles, which is 40 microseconds.

beats.cap: In every case the outcome is the same: PWM low, safe state asserted, and no recovery without the right conditions.
beats.speech: In every case the outcome is the same: P W M low, safe state asserted, and no recovery without the right conditions.

beats.cap: Now the evidence. All 175 directed checks across 12 testbenches pass in the existing RTL regression.
beats.speech: Now the evidence. All 175 directed checks across 12 testbenches pass in the existing R T L regression.

beats.cap: One thousand eight hundred test vectors were replayed through the RTL twice: once with the real decision tree, once with an AI that always claims normal grip. Both gave zero safe-state violations.
beats.speech: One thousand eight hundred test vectors were replayed through the R T L twice: once with the real decision tree, once with an A I that always claims normal grip. Both gave zero safe-state violations.

beats.cap: A separate experiment ran 15 scenarios and 159 checks. A software model met all 159. The RTL met 157; the two misses come from a stimulus that lasted about 240 ADC frames instead of one. A threshold-only baseline met 93, by design, because it has no hysteresis, fault, or stop handling.
beats.speech: A separate experiment ran 15 scenarios and 159 checks. A software model met all 159. The R T L met 157; the two misses come from a stimulus that lasted about 240 A D C frames instead of one. A threshold-only baseline met 93, by design, because it has no hysteresis, fault, or stop handling.

beats.cap: On a noisy crossing near the limit, the baseline toggled seven times. The hysteresis design inhibited once.
beats.speech: On a noisy crossing near the limit, the baseline toggled seven times. The hysteresis design inhibited once.

beats.cap: In simulation, a valid sample reaches PWM low in four clock cycles, 80 nanoseconds. An input change takes 105 to 192 cycles, mostly waiting for the next ADC frame.
beats.speech: In simulation, a valid sample reaches P W M low in four clock cycles, 80 nanoseconds. An input change takes 105 to 192 cycles, mostly waiting for the next A D C frame.

beats.cap: Frame by frame, 577 comparisons between the model and the RTL showed no differences.
beats.speech: Frame by frame, 577 comparisons between the model and the R T L showed no differences.

beats.cap: The decision tree reaches 91.9 percent accuracy on the simulated dataset, against 85.4 for a force-only baseline.
beats.speech: The decision tree reaches 91.9 percent accuracy on the simulated dataset, against 85.4 for a force-only baseline.

beats.cap: What this does not establish: physical safety. Inputs are synthetic, the ADC is a behavioural model, the AI dataset is simulated, 13 step-level model differences remain explained but not removed, and the Wokwi demonstration has not been run.
beats.speech: What this does not establish: physical safety. Inputs are synthetic, the A D C is a behavioural model, the A I dataset is simulated, 13 step-level model differences remain explained but not removed, and the Wokwi demonstration has not been run.

beats.cap: Putting it together. A valid ADC sample arrives.
beats.speech: Putting it together. A valid A D C sample arrives.

beats.cap: One clock cycle each: conditioning, lookup, governor, and PWM.
beats.speech: One clock cycle each: conditioning, lookup, governor, and P W M.

beats.cap: Four cycles later, if any limit is exceeded, the output is low. The AI can advise, but it cannot override.
beats.speech: Four cycles later, if any limit is exceeded, the output is low. The A I can advise, but it cannot override.

beats.cap: Tactile Reflex System.
beats.speech: Tactile Reflex System.

beats.cap: An advisory-only AI, checked with an always-wrong AI. A slope-predictive pre-limit in plain hardware. A self-checking AI link. An instant PWM kill with a latched, fail-safe stop.
beats.speech: An advisory-only A I, checked with an always-wrong A I. A slope-predictive pre-limit in plain hardware. A self-checking A I link. An instant P W M kill with a latched, fail-safe stop.

beats.cap: These are design-level descriptions, not prior-art conclusions.
beats.speech: These are design-level descriptions, not prior-art conclusions.

beats.cap: Proposed next steps, not done: Quartus synthesis and timing, board bring-up, recorded sensor data, and the Wokwi run.
beats.speech: Proposed next steps, not done: Quartus synthesis and timing, board bring-up, recorded sensor data, and the Wokwi run.
